newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, PUT WINDIES IN TO BAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, PUT WINDIES IN TO BAT.

text.p: Sri Lanka won the toss and put West Indies in to bat in the one-off limited overs cricket international at Queen's Park Oval on Friday.
Heavy overnight and early morning showers delayed the start by 50 minutes, resulting in the reduction of overs from 50 to 49 per innings.

West Indies omitted injured batsman Shivnarine Chanderpaul and fast bowler Mervyn Dillon. Middle order batsman Floyd Reifer and leg-spinner Dinanath Ramnarine are making their one-day international debut.
Sri Lanka vice-captain Aravinda de Silva, who is recuperating from a bout of flu, has been named in the touring side.
West Indies - Brian Lara, Stuart Williams, Junior Murray, Carl Hooper, Roland Holder, Floyd Reifer, Curtly Ambrose, Laurie Williams, Dinanath Ramnarine, Franklyn Rose, Courtney Walsh (captain).

Sri Lanka - Roshan Mahanama, Hashan Tillekeratne, Sanath Jayasuriya, Aravinda de Silva, Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Romesh Kaluwitharana, Maravan Atapattu, Muttiah Muralitharan, Kumara Dharmasena, Sanjeeva de Silva, Dulip Liyanage.
